name: Drutopia User
description: Configuration-only Drutopia base feature that ships default form/view displays and a compact view mode for the core User entity.
project_description: Drutopia User is a minimal, configuration-only base feature for the Drutopia distribution. It ships no PHP: it exports three core display configuration objects for the User entity (a default entity form display, a default entity view display, and an extra compact view display) so Drutopia sites get a consistent account form and profile presentation out of the box. It depends only on core modules (field, file, image, path, user). Development is on GitLab (git.drupalcode.org) and mirrored to drupal.org. Documented here from a dev checkout of the 2.0.x branch (the info.yml carries no packaged version).
